```python
def state_dict(
    self, num_workers: int, batch_size: int, num_samples_yielded: Optional[List[int]] = None
) -> Dict[str, Any]:
    if self._iterator is None and num_samples_yielded is None:
        return {}

        return self._state_dict(self._datasets, num_samples_yielded, num_workers, batch_size)
    else:
        return self._iterator.state_dict(num_workers, batch_size)
```
